en-GB.description: Accelerate software delivery from idea to code to production, with a seamless connection to Jira beyond code creation.
en-GB.longDescription:
Accelerate software delivery from idea to code to production, with a seamless connection to Jira beyond code creation.

Note that as of 11th of February 2026, the recentmost Windows version (7.21.23) lags noticeably behind the newest Linux versions (8.14.6 or 10.1.5 depending on the definition of "Server").
en-GB.name: Bitbucket Server
